info.name: Radix Connect API — Phase 1
info.description:
Radix Connect Phase 1.

**Pillars covered**
- People — Profiles + New Joiner Quest
- Connect — Blind Meetups + Mentoring
- Communities — Interest Groups
- Learn & Share — Recommendations + AMA
- Do Together — Events
- Celebrate & Discover — Stories

**Getting started**
1. Set `base_url` (default `http://localhost:8000`).
2. Run `00 · Auth → Demo login` — just a name and the shared password `Radix123`. The token is captured into the `token` variable automatically and every other request inherits bearer auth from the collection.

Sign in as `Anuj Maurya` for the admin role (needed to create Blind Meetup rounds and run matching). Any unrecognised name creates a fresh profile with its own New Joiner Quest. Real email/password auth still works: seeded accounts use `Radix123` as their password.

**Conventions**
- Single resources: `{ "data": { ... } }`. Lists are paginated: `{ "data": [...], "links": {...}, "meta": {...} }`.
- Errors: `{ "message": "..." }`, with `{ "errors": { field: [...] } }` on 422.
- All timestamps are ISO 8601 UTC.

---

**Phase 2 — Make Connection Easier** (folders 11–18)
- People — Who Should I Meet?
- Connect — Cross-location Buddy, Office Hours, Open Coffee / Lunch Invites
- Communities — Challenges
- Learn & Share — Ask Radix, Teach Radix
- Do Together — Open Invites
- Celebrate & Discover — story tags and interest-led discovery (in folder 10)

item.name: 00 · Auth
item.description:
Bearer token auth via Sanctum.

**Demo login** is the quick path: a name plus the shared password `Radix123`. Real email/password register and login are left intact alongside it.

Either way the token lands in the `{{token}}` collection variable automatically, and every other request inherits bearer auth from the collection.

request.description:
**Start here.** The demo sign-in screen asks only for a name and the shared password `Radix123` — no per-user credentials.

An unrecognised name creates a profile on the spot (with its New Joiner Quest), so anyone can sign in and land somewhere useful. `Anuj Maurya` is the seeded admin.

Returns a normal Sanctum token, so every other request behaves exactly as under real auth.
Creates the account and immediately builds their New Joiner Quest.
Seeded accounts all use the password `password`. admin@radix.email has the admin role.
The signed-in user's full profile, including all four tag sections.
Revokes the current token only.
Every dropdown option the UI needs: teams, locations, categories, streams, reaction types.
One call for the home screen: quest, current blind meetup round, pending session requests, upcoming events, open AMAs, latest recommendations and stories.

item.name: 02 · People — Profiles
item.description: Pillar: People. Profiles answer 'why might I want to talk to this person?' rather than acting as an employee directory.

request.description: Free-text across name, job title, intro, team, location and tags.
Tag slug. Use /tags to discover slugs.
kind is one of can_talk_about, can_help_with, want_to_learn, interest.
senior = 6+ years at Radix, junior = under 6. Same split the Blind Meetups use.

body.raw:
{
  "job_title": "Staff Engineer",
  "team": "Engineering",
  "location": "Mumbai",
  "timezone": "Asia/Kolkata",
  "intro": "Backends, hiring and long treks.",
  "pronouns": "he/him",
  "avatar_url": "https://i.pravatar.cc/300",
  "open_to_mentoring": true,
  "open_to_blind_meetups": true
}

request.description: Replaces that one profile section. Tags are created on the fly if new. Send an empty array to clear it.

item.name: 03 · People — New Joiner Quest
item.description: Five people to meet in the first month. Suggestions deliberately cross teams, locations and tenure groups, and each carries a reason.

request.description: Built automatically on first request if it does not exist yet.
status: pending | met | skipped. The quest completes itself once none are pending.

item.name: 04 · Connect — Blind Meetups
item.description: Monthly opt-in. 6+ years at Radix pairs with under 6 years; different team and location are preferred. Meetup lands on the last Friday of the month.

request.description: Includes my_signup and my_pair so the UI knows whether to show Sign up, Withdraw or the match.
`partner` is the other person, from your point of view.
status: proposed | scheduled | completed | missed.
meetup_date defaults to the last Friday of the period's month.
Pairs every signup it can across the tenure split. Re-running replaces the existing pairs.

item.name: 05 · Connect — Mentoring Sessions
item.description: 30 minutes with someone, asked for on the strength of something on their profile. The recipient accepts, declines or suggests another time.

request.description: category: work_knowledge | career | leadership | people | technical | personal_experience.

body.raw:
{
  "recipient_id": 2,
  "topic": "Getting started with BigQuery ML",
  "category": "technical",
  "tag_id": null,
  "message": "Saw this on your profile \u2014 30 minutes whenever suits you?",
  "duration_minutes": 30,
  "proposed_at": "2026-10-02T10:00:00Z"
}

request.description: Recipient only. action: accept | decline | suggest_time.

item.name: 06 · Communities — Interest Groups
item.description: Discovery only. The actual community carries on in WhatsApp, Slack or wherever it already lives.

request.description: The creator becomes the owner and first member.

item.name: 07 · Learn & Share — Recommendations
item.description: Two streams, Work and Leisure. Every recommendation carries a 'why I recommend this'.

request.description: type: book | podcast | article | show | film | course | tool. stream: work | leisure.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Thinking in Systems",
  "creator": "Donella Meadows",
  "type": "book",
  "stream": "work",
  "url": "https://example.com/thinking-in-systems",
  "why": "Changed how I look at feedback loops in our own product."
}

item.name: 08 · Learn & Share — AMAs
item.description: Anyone with interesting experience can host one, async or live.

request.description: format: async | live. For live, set scheduled_at and location.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Ask me about training for HYROX",
  "description": "Six months, one torn calf, finished anyway.",
  "format": "async",
  "status": "open",
  "opens_at": "2026-09-12T00:00:00Z",
  "closes_at": "2026-09-30T00:00:00Z"
}

request.description: Questions come back sorted by upvotes, each with its answers and is_upvoted for the viewer.
Author, AMA host or admin.

item.name: 09 · Do Together — Events
item.description: Anyone creates an activity, others join. Radix Connect does discovery and RSVPs; detailed coordination moves elsewhere.

request.description: The host is RSVP'd as going automatically.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Sunday run at Powai Lake",
  "description": "Easy 8k, coffee after.",
  "category": "sports",
  "starts_at": "2026-09-20T06:30:00Z",
  "ends_at": "2026-09-20T08:00:00Z",
  "location": "Mumbai",
  "is_virtual": false,
  "capacity": 15,
  "interest_group_id": null,
  "status": "published"
}

request.description: status: going | maybe | not_going. Refused with 422 if the event is full.

item.name: 10 · Celebrate & Discover — Stories
item.description: Beyond-work stories. Not recognition or awards — the point is 'I didn't know this about that person.'

request.description: Phase 2. Other people's stories, ranked by how many of their tags match the interests on your profile, then by reactions and recency — so the feed is never empty.
Phase 2. Stories are tagged, which is what makes them discoverable through interests.
category: sport | travel | learning | making | milestone | other. Phase 2: `tags` make the story discoverable through interests.
reaction: clap | heart | mind_blown | inspired. One reaction per person, re-posting replaces it.
A Story can naturally become an AMA. Links both ways; 422 if one already exists.

item.name: 11 · People — Who Should I Meet?
item.description:
Phase 2. Ranks colleagues on the three things the pillar asks for: shared interests, complementary knowledge, and a lack of previous interaction.

Someone you have already been paired with is ranked far down rather than hidden — `previously_connected` tells the UI which is which. Each suggestion carries its `reasons`.

request.description: Prior interaction means a real 1:1 link: a quest person you marked met, a blind meetup pair, a buddy pairing, a mentoring request either way, an office hours booking, or a shared coffee invite. Sharing a group or an event does not count.
"Not right now" — keeps them out of future suggestions permanently.

item.name: 12 · Connect — Cross-location Buddy
item.description:
Phase 2. An ongoing pairing with someone in another office. Unlike Blind Meetups there is no monthly round: you opt in and are paired as soon as someone elsewhere is waiting.

A different location is a hard requirement — if nobody qualifies you stay in the pool.

request.description: Returns `{ signup, pairing }`; either may be null. `pairing.buddy` is the other person.
Tries to pair immediately. 422 if your profile has no location, or you already have an active buddy.
Either buddy can end it. Neither goes back in the pool automatically.

item.name: 13 · Connect — Office Hours
item.description: Phase 2. A host publishes open slots and anyone books one. There is no accept/decline step — that is what Mentoring session requests are for.

request.description: scope: upcoming | past | all. `available_only=1` hides fully booked slots.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Office hours \u2014 anything you like",
  "description": "Work, career, or just a hello.",
  "starts_at": "2026-10-05T10:00:00Z",
  "duration_minutes": 30,
  "capacity": 2,
  "location": "Mumbai",
  "link": null
}

request.description: 422 if full, already started, cancelled, or it is your own slot.
Frees the seat for someone else.

item.name: 14 · Connect — Open Coffee / Lunch Invites
item.description: Phase 2. Deliberately lighter than an Event: a time, a place and a couple of seats.

request.description: scope: open | past | mine | all. kind: coffee | lunch | walk.
`capacity` is seats for guests — the host does not occupy one.
422 if full, cancelled, past, or you are the host.

item.name: 15 · Communities — Challenges
item.description: Phase 2. A challenge counts one thing and `unit` says what — km, books, photos, days. Participants log entries and the leaderboard falls out of the totals.

request.description: scope: active | upcoming | past | mine | all.
The creator is enrolled automatically. Slugs are made unique on collision.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "October Running Challenge",
  "description": "Log every kilometre, treadmill counts.",
  "category": "running",
  "unit": "km",
  "goal_value": 100,
  "starts_on": "2026-10-01",
  "ends_on": "2026-10-31",
  "interest_group_id": null
}

request.description: Includes the ranked leaderboard and your own `my_participation`.
422 if you have not joined, or the challenge is not currently running.

item.name: 16 · Learn & Share — Ask Radix
item.description: Phase 2, and the most useful addition in it. Post a question when you do not know who can help. Tags route the question, and relevant people can either write an answer or simply volunteer to talk — which is often the more useful of the two.

request.description: Open questions, not your own, tagged with something you listed under *can talk about* or *can help with*. This is what makes Ask Radix work without the asker knowing who to approach.
Tags are created on the fly and are how the question reaches the right people.
Includes answers and volunteers.
The "I have done this, come talk to me" path. 422 on your own question.
Asker only — not even an admin. Accepting marks the question answered.
Author, asker or admin.

item.name: 17 · Learn & Share — Teach Radix
item.description: Phase 2. The mirror of Ask Radix: offer an informal session and find out whether anyone wants it before committing to a date. Once `interested_count` reaches `min_interested` the offer can be scheduled, which creates a real Event and RSVPs everyone who said yes.

request.description: Open offers that have reached their interest threshold and just need a date.
format: session | workshop | walkthrough. level: any | beginner | intermediate | advanced.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Figma for people who are not designers",
  "description": "An hour of the basics, no prior experience needed.",
  "format": "workshop",
  "level": "beginner",
  "topic": "Figma",
  "duration_minutes": 60,
  "min_interested": 3,
  "preferred_times": "Weekday afternoons"
}

request.description: Owner only. Creates an Event with `ends_at` derived from `duration_minutes`, and RSVPs the teacher plus everyone interested. Returns the Event. 422 if already scheduled.

item.name: 18 · Do Together — Open Invites
item.description: Phase 2. "Anyone interested?" with no date and no logistics. It becomes a real Event only once enough people have said yes.

request.description: Sorted by interest. Defaults to status=open.
Posting counts as being interested, so the count starts at 1.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Anyone up for a Sahyadri trek?",
  "description": "Nothing planned, just seeing who is keen.",
  "category": "outdoors",
  "rough_timing": "Some weekend next month",
  "location": "Pune"
}

request.description: Author only. Creates an Event in the same category and RSVPs everyone who was interested. Returns the Event. 422 if already converted.
